messages.subject: Fitting INLA models with categorical variables to areal data
parts:
Hello,

I am fitting a Negative Binomial count model for the species dataset. I need to see the trend difference with a categorical variable protected which is a binary variable. I have fitted a model as below. 

model <- inla(y ~ 1 + year * A+ 
              f(year1, model = "ar1") + f(S, model = "bym", graph = g), 
              data = data.frame(year, year1, y), family = c("nbinomial"), 
              control.family = list(link = "log"), 
              control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE, po = TRUE))
Summary of fixed values:


I want to appear the coefficients for protected0 and year:protected0. How can I change my fitted model to see all of these coefficients?

Thanks in advance.
